acceptance: The copied-repository concurrent staging test must start both real OS processes and pass its no-lost-row assertion; the adjacent queue-lock test must remain green, and no production source import may be used to satisfy the fixture.
brief: 併發暫存測試副本缺少長任務依賴而測不到真正的資料競爭
detail: The real-OS concurrent staging regression copies ops/lib/streaming_command.py into a temporary repository but not its sibling ops/task_registry.py dependency. Every subprocess dies during import before staging, so the test reports a setup failure instead of checking whether two read-modify-write stages lose rows. This surfaced as an ops-pytest Gate baseline failure after task_registry was introduced. The fixture must remain isolated and must not weaken the production concurrency assertion.
plan:
1. Reproduce the failure from an untouched primary and confirm it is import/setup, not a staging assertion.
2. Make the fixture copy the minimal sibling module/package files required by streaming_command and its lock dependency, without importing the primary checkout at runtime.
3. Keep the deliberate widened read-modify-write race and both staged rows assertion unchanged.
4. Run the exact single-test acceptance plus the adjacent staging/queue-lock tests.
scope: 一個隔離測試副本的依賴修補與兩個併發測試，不改生產 staging 語意
